header.title: Defensive and offensive strategies
header.description: Security-focused software engineer and OSCP certified (Offensive Security Certified Professional), currently working as a Security Architecture Analyst at Deloitte. Proven experience in Red & Blue Team operations, critical infrastructure hardening, and vulnerability assessments. Specialized in Active Directory attack chains, Linux and Windows environments, security automation, and threat detection with SIEM (Wazuh).

certDesc: Demonstrates advanced hands-on proficiency in reconnaissance, exploitation, Linux/Windows privilege escalation, and lateral movement across enterprise Active Directory domains.
